D1_primary_test_side.not_removed: the two ~2.5 arcsec neighbour pairs with different IDs
remove: (a) every object matching any real lens positive by exact ID
(b) every object matching any simulation-deflector host galaxy by exact ID

D2_sensitivity_training_side.is: D1 plus removal from the test positives of the real lenses that appeared as source-training negatives (14), validation negatives (5) or a simulation deflector (1), each distinct object counted once
D2_sensitivity_training_side.removed_from_which_fold: the fold in which the lens is a test positive

identity: exact Euclid object ID = sign(dec)*(floor(RA*1e7)*1e9 + floor(|Dec|*1e7)); lens positives from id_str; simulation deflectors rebuilt from RA/Dec in data_old/sim_deflectors/deflector_cutouts_clean.npz; negatives as stored (exact) in splits.json; score vectors mapped to IDs through each run's logits/ids.npz, whose order is asserted equal to splits.json

metrics_and_readouts.unchanged: exactly as the paper computes them: the same checkpoints' stored scores, metrics.metric_suite at target FPR 1e-3, the same read-off steps, the paired t-interval on the four confirmatory folds (df=3), and the same bootstrap seeds where a number was bootstrapped

not_recomputable_rule: a number that cannot be computed from stored per-object test scores is marked 'not recomputable (stored scores unavailable)'; a number read only from a summary file is 'original pool only'; no model is loaded and nothing is re-encoded or trained
reads_no_metric: the removal sets are defined by exact Euclid identity only (scripts/exact_ids.contaminant_sets); no score, threshold or metric is read to decide what is removed
what: exclusion rule for measuring split contamination; audit folder only, project read-only
